subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost enforce a fixed 30-second opening-handshake cutoff with no user override?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it intentionally converts very slow handshakes from eventual success into repeated reconnects; repository policy treats that fail-closed availability tradeoff as owner intent rather than an automated correctness choice.

options.title: Accept the fixed cutoff
options.body: Land the plugin-local 30-second timeout, matching existing OpenClaw WebSocket precedent while eliminating indefinite reconnect stalls.

options.title: Require an override path
options.body: Pause merge and define a Mattermost-owned timeout setting only if supported slow-proxy deployments genuinely require handshakes beyond 30 seconds.

recommendation.title: Accept the fixed cutoff
recommendation.body: Land the plugin-local 30-second timeout, matching existing OpenClaw WebSocket precedent while eliminating indefinite reconnect stalls.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced and owns the surrounding Mattermost reconnect behavior.
